name: Howrah Bridge
sourceNote: Main span 1,500 ft between tower centres; towers 280 ft above the monoliths and 76 ft apart at the top; anchor arms 325 ft, cantilever arms 468 ft, suspended span 564 ft; length 705 m; carriageway 21.6 m plus two 4.6 m footpaths; 8.8 m clearance below.

name: Victoria Memorial
sourceNote: Building 338 by 228 ft, rising to 184 ft; central chamber 64 ft in diameter; 16 ft Angel of Victory figure on the dome.
schematic: Drum and dome proportions, the four corner cupolas, and the body height (taken from the building's own height source).

name: Shaheed Minar
sourceNote: The tower is 48 m high, with an Egyptian-style foundation, a Syrian-style column and a Turkish-style cupola.
schematic: Base size, shaft diameter and taper, balcony positions.

name: St Paul's Cathedral
sourceNote: Central spire rises to 201 ft on a square tower; nave 247 ft long and 81 ft wide.
